India Accuses China of Illegal Territory Occupation in J&K, Ladakh

India's Ministry of External Affairs has stated that China has been illegally occupying Indian territory in Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh since 1963. The ministry also rejected any sovereignty claims made by China over these regions. This statement comes amid ongoing border tensions between the two nations.
